title: Lead-magnet drip
description: Four e-mails over eight days after someone downloads a lead magnet: deliver, teach, prove and invite. One journey, four templates, no manual scheduling.

parameters.label: Lead magnet
parameters.description: What the person downloaded, e.g. "the onboarding checklist".

parameters.label: Purpose
parameters.description: The purpose key for the drip; it must include the e-mail channel.

parameters.label: Lead-magnet URL
parameters.description: Where the first e-mail points for the download.

parameters.label: Site URL
parameters.description: Where the invitation points, e.g. a booking page.

parameters.label: Pause between e-mails
parameters.description: An ISO 8601 duration such as P2D; the last wait doubles it so the four e-mails span eight days.

A configured purpose with the e-mail channel

docs:
## The loop

`Lead Magnet Downloaded` → deliver (day 0) → wait → teach (day 2) → wait → prove (day 4) → wait twice the delay → invite (day 8).

The waits use the `delay` parameter, so the eight-day span is four messages at 0, 2, 4 and 8 days by default.

## Before publishing

- The journey needs its four templates published first; submit them together with `artifacts.requestPublishBundle`.
- The trigger is an event, not a segment: your site or form sends `Lead Magnet Downloaded` with the person's id.
- Re-entry is `once`: a person who downloads another magnet later does not restart the drip unless you change the trigger.
checklist: Confirm the event name your site sends when someone downloads the magnet.
Replace the placeholder download URL and the booking link in the first and last e-mails.
Check the delays; the default is 0, 2, 4 and 8 days.
Keep the unsubscribe and preference links in every e-mail.
Publish the four templates and then the journey, or submit them together for one review.
Send the first e-mail to yourself and click the download link.
